content.Le hangul a été inventé pour s'apprendre: Hangul was invented to be learned in a few hours! Each syllable forms a block. A ㅇ at the start of a syllable is silent: 아 reads « a ». ㅓ (eo) is a very open « o », mouth relaxed, like the « u » in « but »; ㅡ (eu) is said with lips stretched, like a smile. Today ㅐ and ㅔ sound almost the same (like the « e » in « bed »).

content.Trois séries à bien distinguer : douce (: Three series to tell apart: soft (ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅈ), aspirated with a puff of air (ㅋ ㅌ ㅍ ㅊ) and tense, with no air and a higher pitch (ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅉ ㅆ). Tip: hold your hand in front of your mouth — you should feel the air on 카 but not on 까.
